crossRefs.note: The Spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.
I heard one speaking to me out of the house; and a man stood by me.
Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.
He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top…

translations.web: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.
translations.bsb: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
translations.kjv: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
